limitations: One short run per backend; timings are descriptive and not a repeated-run confidence interval.
Training wall time includes environment setup/export/reset costs; the FieldSim and Gazebo startup/reset costs differ materially.
The 128-decision benchmark is not an evaluation of task competence. The checkpoint has not been shown to solve held-out tasks.
Gazebo plants remain visual-only; plant detection and damage rewards use the shared FieldSim geometric proxy, not flexible-plant physics or real-robot recognition.
GPU is present on the host but policy/training device was CPU; GPU utilization was not measured.
The Gazebo physics values are the runtime SDF settings; real_time_factor=0 selects unpaced simulation and is not a measured wall/simulation throughput ratio.
